correctness.rationale: The total-variation normalized signed-power functional is nonattaining by a sign discontinuity. Every projection onto its hyperplane is rank one from the identity and has norm 1+||h||infinity by the Daugavet identity. The sharp paired-point Lipschitz bound integrates exactly to the explicit envelope and is attained by a clipped ramp; monotonicity gives threshold and root. Equality conditions force unique optimal h. An all-parameter Taylor fold and large-L expansion give the stated constants. The actual checker.py passed 4,971 supplemental finite assertions; sampling is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 nonattainment theorem motivates a quantitative question about how fast regular projection coefficients approach an unavailable minimal projection. The new exact parametric law gives intrinsic feasibility, uniqueness and a continuum of sharp convergence exponents as well as a distinct universal feasibility cusp. The signed-power density encodes the natural regularity of the sign change, so the parameter is mathematically motivated and not arbitrary enumeration; exact sharpness and the two regimes are not implied by the unconstrained projection constant.
